title: ART POTTERY DUAL SIDED SCULPTU...
reason: Unattributed but ambitious two-sided sgraffito studio pottery; could be by a recognised Australian potter, so the base mark is worth checking in person.
findings: Two views of a hand-built slab stoneware flask-form vase with two tubular necks of different heights, lumpy hand-modelled additions along the shoulder with cobalt blue glaze, and a small pierced lug or spout-like projection at one end. Both faces carry incised (sgraffito) figure drawing: side A a woman's head and shoulders with beads at the neck, side B a reclining or seated figure, over cobalt diagonal brush bands, white glaze drips and a rough grogged body. The drawing is confident, so this looks like an accomplished studio potter rather than a hobby piece. Enlarged both faces, the edges and the neck tops: no signature, initials, impressed mark or label seen; the base is not photographed, so a potter's mark may be there. Maker cannot be identified from the photos.
condition: Rough unglazed grogged surfaces, crazing and cracking of the slip on side B, flaked or rough patches and small nicks at the neck rims and modelled shoulder pieces. No obvious through-cracks visible, but the base and interiors are not shown.
rescore_note: Accomplished unsigned two-sided sgraffito studio stoneware, but maker unidentified, base unseen, and crazing, flaking and nicks: a realistic mix of unknown studio piece and a possible named potter, so about the $30-80 band with some upside.
